sources.title: OpenStax: Fertilisation and early embryonic development

models.L053: Representative butterfly, frog and pea sequences plus strawberry runner branch. Four positions are not equivalent stage durations or universal life histories. Parents do not reverse into their offspring. No survival, counts or growth rates.
models.L054: Compatible viable gametes and suitable later development assumed for successful sexual branch. Pollination alone guarantees neither fusion nor seed survival. Main flower tracks sperm–egg fusion, with the second angiosperm fusion explained in Depth. Runner offspring form without gamete fusion; rooting is conditional.
models.L055: Specified sexual-reproduction cases only. Frog and chicken are representative examples, not universal rules. Fusion and later viability/support are assumed for success; fusion never guarantees survival. Fertilisation site and development site independent. No personal reproduction data.
models.L056: General hormone–receptor signal model, not hormone concentrations or a puberty-timing model. Missing the illustrated response does not stop all cell activity. No fixed maturity age, body comparisons, rankings or diagnoses. Evidence cards are fictional qualitative statements.
